newsitem.title: USA: PSE to list options on HS Resources, others.
newsitem.headline: PSE to list options on HS Resources, others.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange said Monday it will begin trading options on HS Resources Inc, Heartland Express Inc and Seattle Filmworks Inc on Tuesday, December 17.
The exchange said HS Resources options will have opening strike prices of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2 and will be available for January, February, March and June expirations.
The options have been allocated to Omega Options.
Heartland Express options will open with strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 27-1/2 and have initial expirations in January, February, March and June.
J Squared & Assoc have been allocated the options.
Options on Seattle Filmworks will open with strikes of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2 and will be available for January, February, March and June expirations.
The options have been allocated to Kovell Trading LP.
